rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1998 needs a boating safety certificate to run a motorboat over 10 hp, PWC included.
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1998 o después necesita un certificado de seguridad náutica para manejar una lancha de más de 10 hp, incluidas las motos acuáticas.

minAge.note: Under 10: no motorboat. 10-11: over 10 hp only with a parent or designated adult 18+ on board. 12-17: with the certificate or that supervision.

card.feeNote: Classroom courses by volunteer instructors are free; online courses cost $34.95 to $59.95 (IDNR figures).

sources.quote: Persons born on or after January 1, 1998, may operate a motorboat with more than 10 horsepower, including personal watercraft, only if they have a valid boating safety certificate accepted by the Illinois Department of Natural Resources ( 625 ILCS 45/5-18 ).
No person under 10 years of age may operate a motorboat, including personal watercraft ( 625 ILCS 45/5-18 ).
The online course fee varies by course ($34.95-$59.95).
